CRAFTING.FeatureDescription: Create recipes, manage ingredients, and craft items.

CRAFTING.GeneratorSettingsHint: Configure the compendium, component folder, and level tiers used by auto-generation.
CRAFTING.GeneratorCompendiumHint: The label of the compendium to draw components from (e.g. Crafting & Consumables).
CRAFTING.GeneratorFolderHint: Name of the top-level folder inside the compendium that contains the level sub-folders.
CRAFTING.GeneratorLevelsHint: For each level, define the sub-folder name inside the compendium and its point value.

CRAFTING.DropResultHint: Drag an item here to set the result
CRAFTING.DropResultChange: Drag an item here to change it

CRAFTING.EmptyRecipeManager: No recipes yet. Click 'New Recipe' to create one.

ENCOUNTERS.FeatureDescription: Generate random encounters from a compendium and spawn them on the map.

Enabled.Name: Random Encounters: enable
Enabled.Hint: Enables the Random Encounters feature (generator, hub entry, settings menu). Requires reload.

ENCOUNTERS.SettingsHint: Configure the compendium, creature type field, level field, target folder, and CR groups.
ENCOUNTERS.CompendiumHint: The Actor compendium to use for monsters.
ENCOUNTERS.CreatureTypePathHint: Dot-notation path to the creature type field on the actor (e.g. system.details.creatureType)
ENCOUNTERS.TargetFolderHint: Name of the world folder where imported actors will be placed
ENCOUNTERS.LevelPathHint: Dot-notation path to the level field on the actor (e.g. system.details.level)
ENCOUNTERS.ScenarioNone: Click the button to generate a random scenario.
ENCOUNTERS.DifficultyConfigHint: Customize the budget multipliers and monster level range offset for each difficulty level.
ENCOUNTERS.LevelOffsetHint: Value added to the monster level range. Positive = stronger monsters, negative = weaker (e.g. +2 shifts the range from [PL-4, PL] to [PL-2, PL+2]).
ENCOUNTERS.ScenariosHint: List of tactical scenarios the generator randomly picks from.

Warn.NoMonsters: No monsters found with the current filters.
Warn.NoCompendium: No compendium configured. Please configure the encounter settings first.
Warn.NoScenarios: No scenarios configured. Add scenarios in the encounter settings.

Info.ClickMap: Click on the map to place the encounter...

LOOT.FeatureDescription: Generate random loot from compendium folders and assign it to a token.

Enabled.Name: Loot Generator: enable
Enabled.Hint: Enables the Loot Generator feature (generator, hub entry, settings menu). Requires reload.

LOOT.SettingsHint: Configure the compendium, loot groups, gold ranges, and currency path.
LOOT.CompendiumHint: The Item compendium to draw loot from.
LOOT.ActorNameHint: Name of the world actor to use as loot container. It will be placed as a token on the map.
LOOT.CurrencyPathHint: Dot-notation path to the currency field on the actor (e.g. system.currency.gp)
LOOT.LootGroupsHint: Set the number of items to draw from each group.
LOOT.GroupsHint: Each group has a label and a list of compendium folders to draw from.
LOOT.GoldRangesHint: Random gold ranges per encounter difficulty tier.

Warn.NoActor: The selected token has no associated actor.

Warn.NoCompendium: No compendium configured. Please configure the loot settings first.

LIGHTING.PlayerPresetsHint: The people button chooses who sees it in their token menu, the pencil edits it.

LIGHTING.AccessDialogHint: Who can use {name} from their token menu?

LIGHTING.DarknessLevelsHint: Darkness levels available in the control panel.

EXPLORATION.FeatureDescription: Outside combat, limit how many cells each player token moves per turn and advance the clock when everyone is done.
EXPLORATION.Title: Exploration

Enabled.Name: Exploration: enable
Enabled.Hint: Enable the Exploration feature (movement quota outside combat, GM panel with Shift+V). Requires reload.

Quota.Name: Exploration: cells per turn
Quota.Hint: How many grid cells each player token can move before the turn ends.

Seconds.Name: Exploration: seconds per turn
Seconds.Hint: Seconds the world clock advances when the turn ends.

EXPLORATION.Empty: No player token of an online player in this scene.
EXPLORATION.AutoAdvanced: Exploration: every token reached the quota, the clock advanced by {seconds} s.

REACH.FeatureDescription: Color the cells the selected token can reach with one, two or three movements, minus what it already walked this turn.
REACH.ToggleHint: Color the cells reachable by the selected token.
REACH.ResetHint: Reset the distance walked outside combat by the selected tokens (or all of them).
REACH.NoToken: Movement reach: select one of your tokens.
REACH.NoSpeed: Movement reach: speed of {name} not found (field: {path}). The GM must set the sheet field in the module settings.
REACH.Label: Movement: {left} / {speed} {units}

Enabled.Name: Movement Reach: enable
Enabled.Hint: Enable movement reach (Shift+R colors the cells reachable by the selected token). Requires a reload.

SpeedPath.Name: Movement Reach: speed field
SpeedPath.Hint: Path of the actor field holding the speed, e.g. system.attributes.movement.walk (dnd5e) or system.attributes.speed.total (pf2e). Objects use value/total. Empty: try a few common paths.

SpeedUnit.Name: Movement Reach: speed unit
SpeedUnit.Hint: Unit of the value read from the sheet.

SpeedFactor.Name: Movement Reach: multiplier
SpeedFactor.Hint: Multiply the speed read, e.g. 0.3 when the sheet uses feet and the scene meters.

Rings.Name: Movement Reach: movements shown
Rings.Hint: How many full movements to color (1 = green, 2 = yellow, 3 = orange).

ResetOnTime.Name: Movement Reach: reset when time passes
ResetOnTime.Hint: Outside combat the walked distance resets when the world clock advances (Exploration turns included). In combat the Foundry movement history is always used.

HideUnseen.Name: Movement Reach: hide unseen areas
HideUnseen.Hint: Players only see colored cells that are visible or explored, so the reach does not reveal unknown rooms.

Mode.Name: Movement Reach: precision
Mode.Hint: Chosen by every player according to their PC. Computed only while the reach is on and something changes.
Mode.Line: Medium: drop cells behind walls in a straight line
